records.rationale: Set correctly means harden in a contextual cement-setting prediction.

records.originalText: Do come and see us again.
records.finalText: Do come and see us again.
records.rationale: Emphatic do introduces a natural complete invitation to visit again.

records.originalText: You have to have a piece of pie.
records.finalText: You have to have a piece of pie.
records.rationale: Have to is natural enthusiastic emphasis in an ordinary pie offer.

records.originalText: Please be sure to bring some of your friends to the party.
records.finalText: Please be sure to bring some of your friends to the party.

records.originalText: Try it by all means.
records.finalText: Try it by all means.
records.rationale: The unspecified thing to try adds only context-free encouragement after existing by-all-means usage.

records.originalText: I'd very much like to exchange e-mail with you.
records.finalText: I'd very much like to exchange e-mail with you.
records.rationale: Exchange e-mail is natural language for maintaining personal correspondence.

records.originalText: Do come and see us tomorrow.
records.finalText: Do come and see us tomorrow.
records.rationale: Repeats 51300's emphatic visit invitation with tomorrow replacing again.

records.originalText: Sexual harassment has now become a social issue.
records.finalText: Sexual harassment has now become a social issue.
records.rationale: Now become a social issue is an unscoped time-dependent sociological assertion.

records.originalText: The salesman demonstrated how to use the mincer.
records.finalText: The salesman demonstrated how to use the mincer.
records.rationale: The specific appliance demonstration correctly embeds a how-to clause.

records.originalText: The salesman demonstrated how to use the machine.
records.finalText: The salesman demonstrated how to use the machine.
records.rationale: Repeats 51347's demonstration sentence with a less informative machine object.

records.originalText: We have safety deposit boxes.
records.finalText: We have safe deposit boxes.
records.rationale: Use the conventional safe deposit boxes noun phrase without changing the service.

records.originalText: On an island in the Seine, there is a big church called Notre Dame.
records.finalText: On an island in the Seine, there is a big church called Notre Dame.
records.rationale: The named church and Seine-island setting form a stable familiar geographic description.

records.originalText: The sweater shrank in the wash.
records.finalText: The sweater shrank in the wash.
records.rationale: Shrank in the wash is a natural particular clothing-change event.

records.originalText: My sweater shrank in the wash.
records.finalText: My sweater shrank in the wash.
records.rationale: Repeats 51360's sweater-shrinking event with only the owner added.

records.originalText: You should make the most of your ability.
records.finalText: You should make the most of your ability.
records.rationale: Make the most of your ability is a natural ordinary encouragement idiom.

records.originalText: Better wear out shoes than sheets.
records.finalText: Better wear out shoes than sheets.
records.rationale: The unframed elliptical proverb needs interpretation and source context for standalone learning.

records.originalText: One of the pickpockets blew the whistle on the other two.
records.finalText: One of the pickpockets blew the whistle on the other two.
records.rationale: Blew the whistle on is a natural reported-disclosure idiom with explicit participants.

records.originalText: Measurements are different from individual to individual.
records.finalText: Measurements are different from individual to individual.
records.rationale: The measured attribute is absent, leaving the individual-variation claim vague.

records.originalText: May I trouble you to pass me the pepper?
records.finalText: May I trouble you to pass me the pepper?
records.rationale: Repeats the existing polite condiment request, substituting pepper and passing for salt.

records.originalText: Excuse me, but could you tell me the way to the station?
records.finalText: Excuse me, but could you tell me the way to the station?
records.rationale: Semantic repeat of the published could-you-tell-me-where-the-station-is question.

records.originalText: Would you kindly make room for this old woman?
records.finalText: Would you kindly make room for this old woman?
records.rationale: Make room for is a natural complete accommodation request.

records.originalText: Sorry, but I want to tell her this news face to face.
records.finalText: Sorry, but I want to tell her this news face to face.
records.rationale: Face to face naturally specifies a particular news-delivery preference.

records.originalText: Sorry, but I want to tell him this news face to face.
records.finalText: Sorry, but I want to tell him this news face to face.
records.rationale: Repeats 51444 with only the news recipient's gender changed.

records.originalText: Sorry, but I'm not very interested in that subject.
records.finalText: Sorry, but I'm not very interested in that subject.
records.rationale: Repeats the published not-overly-interested personal-topic assessment with an apology adjunct.

records.originalText: Do me a favor by switching off that radio.
records.finalText: Do me a favor by switching off that radio.
records.rationale: Complete radio-switching request correctly uses a by-gerund phrase.

records.originalText: Excuse me. How often do shuttle buses run to downtown New York?
records.finalText: Excuse me. How often do shuttle buses run to downtown New York?
records.rationale: The complete shuttle-frequency question asks rather than asserts an actual timetable.

records.originalText: I'm sorry. Would you mind turning around?
records.finalText: I'm sorry. Would you mind turning around?
records.rationale: Would you mind turning around is a natural polite movement request.

records.originalText: Sorry. I beg your pardon?
records.finalText: Sorry. I beg your pardon?
records.rationale: Beg your pardon is a conventional complete conversational repair request.

records.originalText: Excuse me, but I'm tied up now.
records.finalText: Excuse me, but I'm tied up now.
records.rationale: Tied up now is a conventional personal-unavailability idiom.

records.originalText: Poor eyesight is a handicap to a sportsman.
records.finalText: Poor eyesight is a handicap to a sportsman.
records.rationale: The blanket claim about eyesight limiting sports ignores sport and individual context.

records.originalText: Sports keep us in good shape.
records.finalText: Sports keep us in good shape.
records.rationale: The unqualified sports-health benefit assertion lacks activity and individual scope.

records.originalText: Some students neglect their studies in favor of sports.
records.finalText: Some students neglect their studies in favor of sports.
records.rationale: Some students limits the group in a grammatical particular study-sport tradeoff account.

records.originalText: I love sports. I get that from my father.
records.finalText: I love sports. I get that from my father.
records.rationale: Get that from my father naturally describes a particular shared family interest.

records.originalText: The spokesman confirmed that the report was true.
records.finalText: The spokesman confirmed that the report was true.
records.rationale: Confirmed that explicitly attributes verification to a contextual spokesman.

records.originalText: Everything is in place now.
records.finalText: Everything is in place now.
records.rationale: Semantic repeat of the published everything-is-ready statement.

records.originalText: Let's scrap everything and start over again with a clean slate.
records.finalText: Let's scrap everything and start over again with a clean slate.
records.rationale: Clean slate naturally supports a coherent shared restart proposal.

records.originalText: All things considered, she is a fairly good wife.
records.finalText: All things considered, she is a fairly good wife.
records.rationale: All things considered qualifies an individual relationship evaluation, not a group claim.

records.originalText: Taking everything into consideration, they ought to be given another chance.
records.finalText: Taking everything into consideration, they ought to be given another chance.
records.rationale: The participial discourse phrase naturally qualifies a contextual second-chance recommendation.

records.originalText: Everything depends on whether you pass the examination.
records.finalText: Everything depends on whether you pass the examination.
records.rationale: The whether clause supplies an explicit examination condition naturally.

records.originalText: Everything depends on what you will do.
records.finalText: Everything depends on what you will do.
records.rationale: The unspecified future action gives no independent substance to the dependency statement.

records.originalText: Of all the famous baseball players, he stands out as a genius.
records.finalText: Of all the famous baseball players, he stands out as a genius.
records.rationale: Stands out as a genius is a contextual subjective sporting assessment.

records.originalText: Not all birds can fly.
records.finalText: Not all birds can fly.
records.rationale: Stable elementary biological distinction is correctly expressed by not all.

records.originalText: All human beings are mortal.
records.finalText: All human beings are mortal.
records.rationale: The elementary mortality statement is stable and gives no clinical advice.

records.originalText: It is by no means easy to please everybody.
records.finalText: It is by no means easy to please everybody.
records.rationale: By no means easy is a natural qualified social-difficulty assessment.

records.originalText: Every man cannot be a hero.
records.finalText: Every man cannot be a hero.
records.rationale: Every man cannot is scope-ambiguous between none and not all.

records.originalText: Not all men are wise.
records.finalText: Not all men are wise.
records.rationale: The unframed broad wisdom judgment adds little independently suitable learner content.

records.originalText: He maintained that all occupations should be open to women.
records.finalText: He maintained that all occupations should be open to women.
records.rationale: Maintained that explicitly attributes an inclusive employment-opportunity opinion to one person.

records.originalText: All children are potential geniuses.
records.finalText: All children are potential geniuses.
records.rationale: The all-children-geniuses assertion is an unsupported universal developmental generalization.
